name: Shakkin Shimai 2
source:
Hiroyuki is a high school student. He happens to know that Kaho, his classmate, and Kasumi, Kaho's sister and his classroom teacher, have a lot of outstanding debt their deceased father left. He feels sorry and offers Kasumi to lend some money, but she refuses it. He negotiates with a creditor about it, but their debt is bigger than he expected. To pay off their debt, he starts day trading.... 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090414221558/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010135]Eroge Shop[/url]]

Unlike the story of the previous game, now Hiroyuki helps the sisters for free. Now it's pure love story.
translation:
博之是一名高中生。他偶然得知，同班同学香穗和她的姐姐、同时也是他班主任的霞，背负着已故父亲留下的大笔债务。他对此感到同情，提出借钱给霞，却被她拒绝。于是他与债主协商，才发现债务比预想的更加庞大。为了偿还欠款，他开始进行日内交易……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090414221558/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010135]Eroge Shop[/url]]

与前作的故事不同，这一次博之无偿帮助这对姐妹。这是一段纯爱故事。
